record.original_question: Is there a topological property p that is weaker than sobriety for general T0 spaces but becomes equivalent to sobriety when restricted to Scott spaces of dcpos?

evidence.quote: Question 4.10. Is there a topological property p which is weaker than the sobriety for general T0 topological spaces but equivalent to the sobriety for Scott spaces of dcpos?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall the following definitions. A topological space $X$ is $T_0$ if for any two distinct points there is an open set containing exactly one of them. A nonempty closed subset $C \subseteq X$ is irreducible if whenever $C \subseteq C_1 \cup C_2$ with $C_1, C_2$ closed, then $C \subseteq C_1$ or $C \subseteq C_2$. A $T_0$ space $X$ is sober if every irreducible closed subset of $X$ is the closure $\overline{\{x\}}$ of a unique point $x \in X$.

A directed complete partially ordered set (dcpo) is a poset $(P, \le)$ in which every directed subset has a supremum. The Scott topology on a dcpo $P$ has as its open sets those upper sets $U \subseteq P$ (i.e., $x \in U$ and $x \le y$ imply $y \in U$) such that whenever $D \subseteq P$ is a directed set with $\sup D \in U$, then $D \cap U \ne \emptyset$. The resulting topological space is called the Scott space of $P$.

Question. Does there exist a topological property $\mathcal{P}$ of $T_0$ spaces such that:

(i) $\mathcal{P}$ is strictly weaker than sobriety in the class of all $T_0$ topological spaces (every sober $T_0$ space has property $\mathcal{P}$, but there exists a $T_0$ space with property $\mathcal{P}$ that is not sober); and

(ii) for every dcpo $P$, the Scott space of $P$ has property $\mathcal{P}$ if and only if it is sober?
artifact.category_tag: Sobriety and Scott topology on dcpos
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface a substantial literature on properties weaker than sobriety for Scott spaces (e.g., well-filtered spaces, Rudin spaces, $\omega$-well-filtered spaces), but well-filteredness is known to be strictly weaker than sobriety even on Scott spaces of dcpos (Kou's counterexample, Johnstone's dcpo, and recent constructions of well-filtered non-sober dcpos). No source located explicitly resolves the existence of a property satisfying both conditions of the question, so its current status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: A new dcpo whose Scott topology is well-filtered but not sober
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a dcpo whose Scott topology is well-filtered but not sober, showing well-filteredness does not imply sobriety on Scott spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Well-filteredness, a known weaker-than-sobriety property, fails condition (ii) for Scott spaces of dcpos.

status_evidence.title: On sobriety of Scott topology on dcpos
status_evidence.snippet: Studies conditions on dcpos under which the Scott topology is sober, surveying weaker properties such as well-filteredness and Rudin spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on weaker substitutes for sobriety in Scott spaces, but no property simultaneously satisfying (i) and (ii) is identified.

status_evidence.title: On two problems about sobriety of topological spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open problems about sobriety in topological and order-theoretic settings.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the area still has open questions about characterizing sobriety on Scott spaces.
